title: SB895 (2022 Regular Session): Modifies provisions relating the offenses of unlawful transfer of weapons and the unlawful possession of firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.060 (RSMo): (4) Knowingly sells, leases, loans, gives away, or delivers a firearm to any person whose name appears on the Terrorist Screening Center's No Fly List; or
(5) Knowingly sells, leases, loans, gives away, or delivers a firearm to any person who is a member of a group of two or more individuals, regardless if organized, that engages in or has a subgroup that engages in international or domestic terrorism.
Section 571.060 (RSMo): Unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivisions (2), (3), (4), and (5) of subsection 1 of this section is a class A misdemeanor.
Section 571.070 (RSMo): (3) Such person's name appears on the Terrorist Screening Center's No Fly List; or
(4) Such person is a member of a group of two or more individuals, regardless if organized, that engages in or has a subgroup that engages in international or domestic terrorism.
